title: Locker Rental: membership requirement, tier rank and club access terms by tier
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Locker Rental product line. It states, for each of the six Locker Rental tiers, whether an active club membership is required to rent that tier, the minimum club membership tier ladder rank required, the maximum number of lockers of that tier a member may hold open at a single club, whether a member may rent lockers at more than one club at the same time, whether a rental may be transferred to a locker at a different club, and the fee charged for such a transfer. The rules governing when a rental may actually be created, and how many a member may hold open across clubs, are separate handling matters and are not restated here.

## Membership and club-access table
| Tier | Membership required | Minimum membership tier rank | Max lockers of this tier per club | Multi-club rental allowed | Transfer between clubs allowed | Transfer fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Small Locker | Yes | 0 (any active membership) | 1 | Yes | Yes | $10.00 |
| Medium Locker | Yes | 0 (any active membership) | 1 | Yes | Yes | $10.00 |
| Large Locker | Yes | 0 (any active membership) | 1 | Yes | Yes | $10.00 |
| Premium Climate-Controlled Locker | Yes | 4 | 1 | Yes | Yes | $15.00 |
| Day-Use Locker | No | 0 (any active membership, where one applies) | 1 | Yes | No | $0 |
| VIP Locker Suite | Yes | 5 | 1 | Yes | Yes | $0 |

## Equivalent restatement (by question)
- Is club membership required to rent a Day-Use Locker? No; this is the only tier open to non-members.
- What minimum membership tier ladder rank does the VIP Locker Suite require? Rank 5, the highest of any tier.
- May a member rent a Day-Use Locker at a second club while already renting one elsewhere? Yes; multi-club rental is allowed for every tier, including the Day-Use Locker.
- Is a fee charged to transfer a VIP Locker Suite rental to a different club? No; the transfer fee fixed for this tier is zero, though the transfer itself is allowed.

## Points of judgement
A minimum membership tier rank of 0, as fixed for the Small Locker, Medium Locker, Large Locker and Day-Use Locker tiers, means any active membership tier satisfies the rank requirement for those tiers; only the Premium Climate-Controlled Locker (rank 4) and the VIP Locker Suite (rank 5) fix a rank above zero, so only those two tiers narrow eligibility to members holding a sufficiently high membership tier.
